# Planck.js

`planck.mjs`: Planck.js 1.4.2, the unmodified ESM distribution from
https://registry.npmjs.org/planck/-/planck-1.4.2.tgz (`package/dist/planck.mjs`).

MIT license: see `LICENSE.txt`. Included locally so 독박빼기 (`js/games/pullout.js`) and 독박 시소 (`js/games/seesaw.js`) do not need
to download the physics engine from a CDN at runtime.
